blurb: Established in 1900, Bear Hill Golf Club stands as one of Massachusetts' enduring private 9-hole golf clubs with a rich history of continuous operation. Beyond the greens, our club presents a diverse range of activities, including tennis, pickleball, pool, and engaging social events tailored for both families and adults.
